errors.text: The proposed yield-strength threshold of >800 MPa is substantially below the baseline alloy's implied yield strength, so it does not establish a simultaneous strength increase over HfMoTaTiZr.

The mechanism incorrectly states that the pre-existing HCP phase transforms into a stronger phase during straining; the cited refractory-alloy evidence instead concerns stress-induced BCC-to-HCP transformation.
The hypothesis does not reconstruct the Cr-addition intervention, reticulated Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves phase, or its crack-deflection/plasticity-compensation mechanism.

Evidence from FCC CoCrFeMnNi is not valid support for SFE-controlled twinning in this BCC refractory system, and no cited evidence supports Al or Si substitution while retaining the required metastability.
The experiment changes Mo content, cryogenic deformation, heat treatment, and Al/Si substitution together, preventing attribution of any strength-ductility improvement to TRIP.
